Flexible Learning Options

After Enrolling in a Digital Command Path or Course

When you enroll in a Digital Command course, you will receive an official receipt. If applicable, you can forward this receipt to your team for reimbursement. If you require customization, such as adding your organization’s name or address, contact us at info@digitalcommand.co, and we’ll assist you promptly.

Certificate of Completion

Upon successfully completing your Digital Command course, you’ll receive a Certificate of Completion—a testament to your mastery of critical digital skills. This certificate will feature your name, course specifics, and the official Digital Command logo. Here's what you can expect:

  • Your personalized certificate will align with our "Digital First, Job Second" philosophy.
  • It proves your dedication to acquiring future-ready skills.

Email Template for Manager Approval

If you need your manager’s approval to enroll in a Digital Command course, we’ve created an email template to make the process seamless.

This template highlights how your training will benefit not just your career but your organization’s goals.

Subject: Request to Enroll in Digital Command Course Hi [Manager's Name], I've identified a Digital Command course that I believe will significantly benefit our team and align with our organization's goals. This course is part of Digital Command's suite of programs designed to empower professionals with digital leadership skills and practical tools tailored for immediate application. A few highlights of this course: • Direct access to leading instructors with expertise in [specific skill or focus]. • Practical, hands-on sessions to apply new strategies to real-world challenges. • The latest thinking and frameworks to solve the digital transformation issues we face today. I'm confident this training will enable me to: • Drive better outcomes by mastering [specific skill]. • Share actionable insights with the team to elevate our collective impact. The course cost is [price], and you can explore the details, including the instructor's background and agenda, here: [course link]. This training aligns with our mission to stay competitive and adapt in today's fast-paced digital economy. I'd love to discuss this further if you have questions. Thank you, [Your Name] P.S. Several teams have found value in sending multiple participants to Digital Command courses to create a shared foundation of skills and accelerate transformation. Perhaps we can consider this approach?

Why Choose Digital Command?

Digital Command isn’t just about learning—it’s about transformation. Our courses are specifically designed to equip you with actionable skills to excel in the digital-first world. With Digital Command, you’re not just keeping pace—you’re leading the way.
